scope: Evidence-linked capability assessment, not an overall completion percentage.
source_applicability: Current institutional runtime, contracts, resources and test bytes match the tested candidate. Iteration-006 adds evidence/scenario/handoff artifacts, not production runtime changes.

capabilities.name: Candidate/context binding
capabilities.limits: Drift-sensitive supplied-data equality, not authenticated provenance or automatic association with the continuation inventory.

capabilities.name: Attributed bearings and cross-cutting dissent
capabilities.limits: Two actual analytical bearings and dissent on fixed source; all same-platform and unverified. Eight canonical bearing identities remain unchanged; this run uses a bounded subset.

capabilities.name: Initial/meta/final reconciliation
capabilities.limits: Executed source-backed structural workflow. Only the validator-specific hypothesis receives a rejection recommendation; broad findings and dissent remain. API classification remains fixture_only.

capabilities.name: Assurance DAG planning/readiness/result ingestion
capabilities.limits: Inert procedures and externally supplied assertions only; no arbitrary execution, independently authenticated result or approval.

capabilities.name: Evidence eligibility and lifecycle/cache
capabilities.limits: Explicit status events, revision-sensitive dependency proofs and replay checks work; trusted administration, truth and custody are unsupported.

capabilities.name: Controlled stop and exact resume
capabilities.limits: Historical synthetic technical node retried without relabeling real verifier evidence. Downstream synthetic work remains stale. Source-backed pending node is retention_security, not a universal assurance restart.

capabilities.name: Rotation and reopening
capabilities.limits: Bounded attributed response coverage and drift/status reopening; not semantic truth, exhaustive sensitivity or recurrence analysis.

capabilities.name: Generic persistence assurance admission
capabilities.limits: Executed observation: assurance semantic validator and attachment helper reject an invalid recommendation; generic envelope validation/inspection admit it structurally. Existing coordinator must compose semantic checks; no storage.apply of the invalid record occurred.

capabilities.name: Formula/resilience references
capabilities.limits: 58 references, 27 design contracts and seven literal diagrams preserved. Some existing structural predicates are executable; no full calibrated numerical model, invented weights or empirical effectiveness.

capabilities.name: Selected deployment
capabilities.limits: Usable installed offline supplied-data SDK with isolated noneditable origins. New scenario ran inside the checkout with SDK-only dependencies; historical external full-base validation remains separate. Hosted profile/tool enforcement is unverified.

capabilities.name: Independent reproduction/audit
capabilities.limits: G5 NOT_RUN; actor/model/lane separation does not establish authenticated independent verification.

capabilities.name: Operational authority and approval
capabilities.limits: Draft recommendations only. No adopted governance, disposition authorization, approval, activation, release or retirement.

capabilities.name: Evidence acceptance
capabilities.limits: 151 missing historical logs; 11 residual owner-review scan findings; unintended timestamp captures require owner-reviewed disposition. Scanning is scoped, not repository/history-wide clean certification.

capabilities.name: Rendering and hosted profiles
capabilities.limits: Renderer modules/CLI unavailable: NOT_RUN. Text alternatives preserved. No hosted profile activated or enforcement observed.

institutional_result.recommendation: Enhance the existing continuation coordinator with assurance semantic admission/recovery checks, explicit candidate association or unbound classification, and required history-extension checks; do not create another agent or memory store.
institutional_result.status: Source-backed recommendation with one executed admission-consistency observation; not implemented remediation or authorized adjudication.

overall: Useful inactive SDK and bounded source-backed workflow; neither full Rubber-Duck operation nor institutional migration completion.
